PQT.Settings.Title: Quest Tracker Settings
PQT.Settings.ExportHint: Download a backup of all current quests as a JSON file.
PQT.Settings.ImportHint: Upload a previously exported JSON file. Imports will be added as new quests.
PQT.Settings.ExportError: Export failed. Check console for details.
PQT.Settings.ImportError: Import failed. Check console for details.
PQT.Settings.AllowRewardDragHint: When enabled, players can drag item rewards from the Quest Sheet directly into their character sheets. Disable this to prevent unintended early access to reward items.
PQT.Settings.ObjectivesAboveDescriptionH: When enabled, the Objectives section appears above the Description on the Overview tab — useful when quests have long descriptions or images.
PQT.Settings.AllowPlayerManageAvailableQ: Allow Players to Manage Available Quests
When enabled, players can accept quests marked as Available (moving them to Active), and transition them to Completed, Failed, or back to Available.
PQT.Settings.AllowPlayerEditPartyQuests: Allow Players to Edit Group Quests
PQT.Settings.AllowPlayerEditPartyQuestsH: When enabled, players can collaboratively edit player-created group quests and their objectives.
PQT.Settings.AllowPlayerCheckObjectives: Allow Players to Check Off Objectives
PQT.Settings.AllowPlayerCheckObjectivesH: When enabled, players can check off objectives on active quests even if they cannot edit the quest details.
PQT.Settings.NotifyGMOnPlayerEdit: Notify GM in Chat on Player Changes
PQT.Settings.NotifyGMOnPlayerEditHint: Sends a private whisper message to the GM whenever a player modifies a quest or updates objectives.
PQT.Field.AllowPlayerRewardsHint: When enabled, players can add reward items and adjust gold on this group quest.
PQT.Audit.Title: Quest Tracker: Quest Updated
PQT.Keybinding.Toggle.Name: Toggle Quest Log
PQT.Keybinding.Toggle.Hint: Open or close the Quest Log window.
PQT.Settings.AllowPlayerCreateMainQuests: Allow Players to Create Main Quests
When enabled, players can create and designate Main Quests. When disabled, players can only create Side Quests and Personal Quests.
PQT.Settings.RescueHint: Opens the assistant to clean up orphaned quests, ID conflicts, and legacy journal remnants.
PQT.Rescue.Title: Phil's Quest Tracker – Emergency Cleanup Assistant
PQT.Rescue.FixAllIdsHint: Safety repair: Resolves outdated or mismatched internal IDs from previous versions. Nothing is deleted—all your quests, descriptions, and rewards remain 100% intact.
PQT.Rescue.FixNone: All quest IDs are already clean.
PQT.Rescue.LegacyCleaned: Legacy journal entries were completely cleaned up.
PQT.Action.CopyQuestIdHint: Click to copy Quest ID to clipboard (or drag to Hotbar)
